source_title: One Piece Creator Oda Unveils 3 New Ancient Gods
source_excerpt:
One Piece is currently in the climax of the Elbaf arc, where a cataclysmic battle is currently unfolding in the Underworld as three of the strongest Gods in the entire world collide. In One Piece chapter 1179, released officially on April 5, 2026, in Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 19, Nerona Imu, the King of the entire world and a primordial God, made his appearance on Elbaf. To combat his influence, the two strongest ancient Gods, who were once each other's arch-nemeses, those being the Black Lightning Dragon Nidhoggr and the Sun God Nika, have combined their forces. This battle will officially decide the fate of the entire world.
One Piece currently awaits the release of chapter 1197 on November 1, 2026, and needless to say, this cataclysmic battle is going to show us more abilities of these three legendary ancient Gods from a bygone era.
One Piece Unveils Akuma, Nika, And Nidhoggr As 3 Ancient Gods
The existence of Gods in the world of One Piece was considered to be a myth by the vast majority of fans for the longest period of time. Gods were first teased with the release of One Piece Chapter 287 on August 11, 2003, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Double Issue 37-38. Back then, no fan truly believed that these Gods were real and were actually fighting against one another in a bygone era.
"God of the Sun, God of the Rain, God of the Forest, God of the Earth, please take this woman's blood and save our village from disaster." — Shandians introduce 4 Gods, One Piece Chapter #287
With the release of One Piece Chapter 1044 on March 28, 2022, the first primordial God awakening was finally shown to us as Luffy tapped into the awakening of Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika , bringing the Sun God and the Warrior of Liberation back into the third world.
In the Elbaf arc of One Piece, specifically in Chapter 1175, which was officially released on March 2, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 14, Eiichiro Oda unveiled the Black Lightning Dragon, Nidhoggr, yet another God from the old era. Long ago, this power was wielded by the God of war of Elbaf, whose strength was said to be great enough to clash evenly with the sun God Nika.
"In Elbaf, we have a legend about a Warrior God. He wielded a weapon known as Ragnir - Iron Lightning - and turned into an enormous dragon to face off against the Sun God!! He fought alongside a trusted, loyal ice squirrel known as Ratatoskr." — Jarul explains the War God Nidhoggr, One Piece Chapter #1175
Now, in the modern era, this power belongs to none other than the Accursed Prince Loki. While the ancient God Nidhoggr once opposed Sun God Nika, this time they stand together against an even greater threat in the form of yet another ancient God, which Oda revealed to us in One Piece Chapter 1179 on April 5, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 19. This God is none other than the Demon God of the One Piece world and the entity that rules as the King, Nerona Imu . Out of all three ancient Gods of the One Piece world that we have seen so far, Nerona Imu, who wields the power of the Akuma no Mi and dominates as the King of the World, possesses the strongest ancient God abilities. His display in Elbaf has made it quite clear that his powers are even greater than those of the Sun God Nika and the God of War Nidhoggr combined.
Creator of the World Government (One of the First 20)
Power: Akuma no Mi (The Devil's Fruit)
— Imu's introduction box, One Piece Chapter #1179
Why Akuma Is The Strongest God Of All In One Piece
Nerona Imu wasn't born as a God, as was clearly shown to us in the climax of the Elbaf arc, specifically during the Imu Vs Loki battle. He was once a reserved person who did not have much power at his disposal. However, given that the vast majority of the Void Century history remains unknown, what we can say is that Imu came to possess the power of the Akuma no Mi at some point. Upon consuming this Devil Fruit, he became a powerful God of the world. With the power of the Akuma no Mi, Imu gained two distinct abilities, the first of which is God's Domination.
As explained by Nerona Imu and Loki in One Piece Chapter 1181 on April 27, 2026, God's Domination allows the former to bestow his powers to different people in a multitude of ways. Imu can either use the power of Domi Reversi to turn someone into their loyal demonic slave or grant someone Covenants, which have three distinct stages, to bestow unique abilities in exchange for eternal servitude. Both of these powers grant Imu's servants tremendous capabilities alongside infinite regeneration and immortality. However, on the flip side, they become loyal slaves of Imu, which makes his Devil Fruit akin to that of a demon God.
Loki: So your power is God's Domination? Think you mean a contract with the Devil!
Imu: God? Devil? What is the difference?
— Loki and Imu explain God's Domination, One Piece Chapter #1181
Another power that Imu wields is the Black Flame of Omen, explained to us in One Piece Chapter 1181. Omen is a power that exists within all living beings but can only be manifested through corruption . These black flames can be used offensively and defensively, and as confirmed recently in One Piece Chapter 1194, they stand as a direct counter to even Conqueror's Haki.
"Omen is my military might. It's a power that dwells within all living things. People crave power. However, if the power they crave is obtained through ease, it leads to corruption." — Imu explains Maki, One Piece Chapter #1181
Put together, these two powers make Nerona Imu the strongest ancient God of the One Piece world compared to Nika and Nidhoggr, and the proof of that lies in the climax of the Elbaf arc. In One Piece chapter 1186, Nerona Imu defeated the God of War of Elbaf easily. In chapter 1188, Nerona Imu almost killed the Sun God Nika , and he managed to do all this despite being severely nerfed, as confirmed to us by Saint Sommers in One Piece chapter 1182, released on May 10, 2026.

New Ancient God Devil Fruits Set To Be Revealed in The Final Saga
So far, One Piece has unveiled to us three Ancient Gods properly, but there are many others that are set to be unveiled as the story continues. For one, the Rain God Zaza has already been revealed to us and has already been set up in One Piece chapter 1182 on May 10, 2026. This God was feared by the Celestial Dragons once, alongside Nika, and it is about to make its reappearance soon enough. It is highly likely that Vivi, the princess of Alabasta, will go on to wield the power of this God .
“We were born in a place so high, it's above all the rain clouds. Water coming down from the sky? It's a mysterious terror! After the people of D and Nika, it was the most common boogeyman they warned us about...that in the lower world, there's a monster called the Rain God that dumps water on top of your head!” — Saint Killingham Unveils Zaza, One Piece Chapter #1182
Similarly, there are the Earth God and the Forest God, whose powers remain to be seen right now. These Gods played a significant role in the Second World, as confirmed in One Piece chapter 1138 on February 3, 2025. All these Gods will make their appearance one after another, making One Piece's final saga a tremendous lineup of some of the mightiest ancient Gods of the world.
All the latest manga chapters of One Piece by Eiichiro Oda, published in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump, are available to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
